sentences.text: He submits that, admittedly, pursuant to the arrangement, the petitioner company had, with the complainant, a sum of 15.5 crores have been paid to the Respondent No.2 / complainant.
5. He submits that vague allegations have been levelled that the digital signatures of the complainant have been misused.

He submits that, admittedly, the parties had a commercial arrangement and the digital signatures were, at some stage, used by the petitioner company for the purpose of statutory compliances such as filing of Goods and Services Tax, etc.

He submits that the parties have been working together however, there has been a fall out due to financial disputes.
6.
He submits that the petitioner had, in fact, terminated the commercial arrangement and had also invoked the arbitration on 02.12.2023.
He submits that, even though the complaint was allegedly given to the Police prior to invocation of arbitration, the FIR was registered only in the month of March, 2024.
7. Issue notice.
8. Mr. Pradeep Gahalot, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file Status Report.
9. Mr. Rakesh Malhotra, learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the complainant/ Respondent No. 2.
He seeks time to file a reply.

10. Let the status report, be filed before the next date of hearing.
11.
List on 29.07.2024 CRL.M.A. 8131/2024 (for interim stay)
12. The learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits that This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/03/2024 at 22:20:39 since the FIR has been registered against the company, the officers of the company are being harassed and the summons are being issued by the investigating agency, even to the company officials who are not aware of any transactions between the parties.
13.
He, however, seeks liberty to withdraw the present application and file an appropriate application as and when a summon is issued to any individual company official.
He also seeks liberty to file an application for grant of interim protection to the individual concerns.
14. The application is dismissed with the aforesaid liberty.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J MARCH 14, 2024 "SS"
